app.status.ready_no_data: Ready. Crime data not synced yet
app.blocked: Zillow is showing a challenge. Solve it in the Chrome window that opened.
app.legend.title: Area read
app.no_crime_data: Crime data has not been synced, so safety scores currently rest on the area read alone. Run npm run sync once, then rescore.
app.pin_name_placeholder: Optional: name it first, then click the map
add.placeholder: Paste a Zillow link, type an address, or press Ctrl+V to paste screenshots (as many as you like)
add.shots_hint: {n} screenshots go to the reader together, treated as parts of one listing. The box above can hold the source URL (needed for refresh).
add.address_only_hint: An address on its own scores the location, without listing details. Good for "what is this corner like".
preview.needs_review: These were hard to read in the screenshots. Check them before saving: {fields}
preview.composite_note: Combined sort value {n} (switched on in settings)
preview.avoid_body: Inside {name}. Safety capped from {from} down to {to}.
preview.edit_hint: Save when you are done. Note that changing the address does not rescore; paste it again for that.
list.empty: Nothing saved yet. Paste a link or a screenshot above to start.
list.empty_shortlist: Shortlist is empty. Press the star on a listing to add it.
detail.listed_basis_days: The source gave a day count, so the date is worked backwards
detail.listed_basis_date: The source gave the date directly
detail.avoid_body: Inside {name}. Safety capped from {from} down to {to}.
detail.notes_placeholder: How it felt in person, what the landlord said, what to ask about
detail.blur_saves: Saves when you leave this box
anchor.pin_mode_title: Click a spot on the map to place it
anchor.pin_mode_hint: Click a spot on the map. It will use the name filled in above.
anchor.both_required: Both name and address are needed
anchor.weight_title: How much this place counts toward convenience
anchor.footnote: Weight drives the "places you go" part of convenience, which is 40% of it. Rescore below to apply a change to listings you already saved.
anchor.empty: No pins yet. Convenience will be scored without the "places you go" term until you add one.
settings.budget_hint: Does not affect scoring. Whether a rent is worth it is your call; this line only marks the card and gives the list something to sort on.
settings.budget_curve_hint: Full marks below the sweet spot, tapering upward, and still falling past the reference line, so two listings that are both over it still sort against each other.
settings.composite_toggle: Blend safety and convenience into one number
settings.composite_warn_title: Off by default, and worth leaving that way
settings.composite_warn_body: These two run against each other in San Francisco (measured at r = -0.32): the safe places are far out, the convenient ones are busy. Averaging flattens the difference. Across 14 test addresses six landed in the same bucket, and safety 16 came out ahead of safety 27. Switch it on only when you need a rough sort key.
settings.avoid_hint: Somewhere you have walked and decided against. A listing inside one has its safety score capped at the number you set, and the card says so rather than quietly lowering it. Any neighbourhood name works, including ones the map does not label, such as Dogpatch.
settings.avoid_empty: None. This ships empty on purpose: someone else's no-go list is a prejudice you have not checked.
data.sort.name: By name
data.col_title.personal: Robbery, assault, sex offences, homicide, weapons
data.col_title.street: 311 reports of human waste and needles
data.areas_footnote: These are raw counts per area, not scores. A listing's safety score is computed with distance decay around that listing, so it will not match the area average here. That is deliberate.
data.window: Sample window: personal and property {personal} months, street {street} months
data.incident_sources: Incident data: SFPD incident reports, 311 reports, and police dispatch calls, all from DataSF. Every sync goes straight to the city API.
data.no_sources: Area data has not loaded, so there is no reference list.
bd.zone_broader: note: written about the whole area
bd.terrain: terrain     {m}m climb to the nearest station ({note})
bd.missing: not read    {list} (weight shared out among the rest)
err.listing.url_not_supported: Only Zillow links are read automatically. Paste a screenshot for anything else.
err.listing.zillow_only: That is not a Zillow URL.
err.listing.unreadable: Could not read that page as a listing. Use a screenshot instead.
err.listing.no_address_in_images: No full address visible in those screenshots. Add one showing it, or type the address.
err.listing.geocode_failed: Could not find that address in San Francisco.
err.listing.located_but_ungeocodable: Read the listing but could not place its address on the map.
err.listing.empty_input: Paste a Zillow link, an address, or a screenshot.
err.listing.bad_image: Image {index} is not in a format we can read.
err.candidate.expired: That preview has expired. Paste it again.
err.anchor.location_required: Give the place an address or coordinates.
err.anchor.geocode_failed: Could not find that address in San Francisco.
err.settings.ideal_above_max: The sweet spot cannot be higher than the reference line.
err.settings.weights_both_zero: The two weights cannot both be zero.
err.settings.not_a_boolean: {path} has to be true or false.
err.settings.avoid_invalid: Each avoided area needs a name and a cap between 0 and 100.
err.ai.no_key: This needs an Anthropic API key. Screenshot reading and the written note are off without one; everything else works.
err.ai.truncated: The model ran out of room before finishing.
err.fetch.chrome_missing: Could not find Chrome. Set CHROME_PATH to your chrome.exe.
err.fetch.blocked: Zillow is showing a challenge. Solve it in the Chrome window that opened.
note.no_crime_data: crime data not synced yet, area read only
note.steep: uphill on the way home, and not a small one
map.summary_scope: What follows is written about {name} as a whole
fetch.pacing: Waiting {seconds}s so Zillow does not throw a challenge
fetch.warming: Opening the Zillow home page first
fetch.challenge: Zillow is asking for a challenge. Switch to that Chrome window, hold the button, then press Done here.
fetch.still_blocked: Still blocked after the challenge. Use the screenshot path instead.
fetch.no_data_shape: The page did not have the expected data. Zillow may have changed, or the URL is not a listing.
data.not_synced: Incident data has not been synced. Run npm run sync and the numbers appear here.
method.excluded: Drug offences are deliberately excluded: in San Francisco those counts track how hard the police are working, not how dangerous a block is.
method.filed_online: Reports filed online are excluded, because the coordinate is where the reporter was, not where it happened.
method.per_capita: No per-capita rate: McLaren Park has 155 registered residents and Golden Gate Park has 49, so dividing by population would make the parks the most dangerous places in the city.
method.night: Incidents between {from}:00 and {to}:00 count {x}x toward the score.
method.decay: Distance decay around the listing itself (half-weight parameter {metres}m), not an average inside a radius.
settings.home_hint: The place you go most, usually work or school. Every listing shows how long the trip there takes. It does not change any score.
settings.home_located: Located. Clear the address and save to remove it.
err.settings.home_geocode_failed: Could not find that address in San Francisco.
err.settings.home_invalid: The core address needs both an address and a location.
map.home_hint: commute times are measured to here
commute.estimate_note: Estimate using walking, BART and Muni Metro. Buses not included.
commute.no_home: Set a core address under Pins and settings to see the commute for every listing.
